nodes.name: Gate 0: Spec, stack and prototype
nodes.description: PASS when the PRD and ADRs 0001 to 0004 are on main; ADRs record the stack questions Gate 1 depends on ([KAT-3729](https://linear.app/kata-sh/issue/KAT-3729/decide-the-stack-questions-that-gate-1s-first-slices-depend-on)); Gannon has picked one of three prototype variants each for the issue list ([KAT-3725](https://linear.app/kata-sh/issue/KAT-3725/prototype-the-issue-list)) and the issue page ([KAT-3726](https://linear.app/kata-sh/issue/KAT-3726/prototype-the-issue-page)); and Gate 1 is sliced into Linear issues in delivery order, with the evidence recorded on [KAT-3728](https://linear.app/kata-sh/issue/KAT-3728/gate-0-check-cut-gate-1-into-slices-and-record-the-evidence).

nodes.name: Gate 1: Groundwork ships from Punchlist
nodes.description: PASS when Groundwork's and Punchlist's own issues have run from Punchlist for 14 consecutive days with no fallback to Linear; at least 80% of Groundwork's merged pull requests started from a runner dispatch; no agent action landed on an issue in a status locked to people; and no run was lost or duplicated across runner restarts. Every slice issue in this milestone is Done, and a gate check records the evidence.
